api_docs.title: API Documentation
api_docs.intro: This documentation provides instructions on how to programmatically access pricing data and perform cost calculations using our provided APIs. This is ideal for integrating cost estimation into your own applications or backend services.
api_docs.pricing_api_desc: To get the raw pricing data for each service, you can make a simple GET request to the corresponding static JSON endpoint. These endpoints do not require authentication.
api_docs.calc_api_desc: For dynamic calculations, we recommend implementing a POST endpoint on your backend. This endpoint should accept a JSON object detailing the services to be estimated and return a calculated cost summary. The logic for this calculation is available in the `services/calculationService.ts` file of this application.
